Two willing creatures within 5 squares, one donor and one recipient. You can be either. Move up to 6 HP from the donor to the recipient. The donor must remain above 0 HP. The recipient cannot exceed maximum HP. This is a transfer, not healing: no Life resistance applies, and Moser’s law does not add another cost. A Dying recipient who rises above 0 HP clears its death marks.
